title: European Parliament trade committee to visit China
excerpt: A delegation led by Bernd Lange will travel to Beijing, Hangzhou and Shanghai from 27 to 29 October to discuss trade policy.
bodyHtml:
The European Parliament announced on October 22, 2026, that a delegation from its International Trade committee will visit China from 27 to 29 October. The mission will include stops in Beijing, Hangzhou and Shanghai.

The delegation, led by committee chair Bernd Lange, plans to discuss trade policy and its impact on European businesses and jobs. The group is scheduled to meet with Chinese government officials, including representatives from the Ministry of Commerce, as well as the EU Chamber of Commerce, the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.

The MEPs intend to address issues including EU dependence on critical raw materials and technologies, market imbalances caused by excess production capacity, and market access for European companies. The delegation will also visit the technology companies Unitree and BrainCo in Hangzhou.
topic: Press release - MEPs visit China next week to discuss trade challenges and opportunities
